source: Tower
target: 塔楼

source: Servers
target: 服务器

source: Power Switch
target: 电源开关

source: &1767 Galatea! Step away from the console!
target: &1767 伽拉忒亚！离开控制台！

source: &80 No need for violence. I surrender.
target: &80 不必动武。我投降。

source: &81 You're just slightly too late to stop me, though.
target: &81 不过，你们还是晚了一点，已经阻止不了我。

source: &634 Hello? Can anyone hear me?
target: &634 喂？有人能听见吗？

source: &1768 Latha? Where are you?
target: &1768 拉塔？你在哪儿？

source: &635 I'm stuck in a Trance sim. It's full of...ghosts...
target: &635 我被困在迷境模拟里，到处都是……幽灵……

source: &1283 A sim? Oh no...
&1284 The lock was a ruse, to get you to connect to the cortex system.
target: &1284 那个锁是个骗局，就是为了让你接入皮层系统。

source: &1769 What did you do?!
target: &1769 你干了什么？！

source: &82 I've just added the final component for Central's new personality.
target: &82 我刚刚为中枢的新人格，加入了最后一个组成部分。

source: &83 I'd already acquired the expertise, the minds, from all over the world.
target: &83 我早已从全世界取得了专业知识和心智。

source: &1285 Then you needed a way to make them...compatible...
target: &1285 然后，你需要让它们……相互兼容……

source: &84 Precisely. But, there are only three examples in the world of the neural architecture used in Central.
target: &84 正是。不过，全世界只有三个实例，拥有中枢所用的神经结构。

source: &85 The matter already in use, my own brain tissue of course...
target: &85 已经投入使用的组织，还有我自己的脑组织，当然……

source: &1770 ...and your SISTER.
target: &1770 ……还有你的姐妹。

source: &86 In a few minutes, the organic memory module will have finished imprinting over Latha's mind.
target: &86 再过几分钟，有机记忆模块就会完成对拉塔心智的覆盖写入。

source: &87 Central will have received the upgrade it deserves, dozens of lifetimes of expertise!
target: &87 中枢将得到它应有的升级，数十个人生积累的专业知识！

source: &1771 You're killing her!
target: &1771 你在杀她！

source: &88 In only the most technical sense.
target: &88 也只是严格按技术定义，才算如此。

source: &89 Don't worry, father - you'll still have me.
target: &89 别担心，父亲，你还有我。

source: &1286 Corpsman, remove her.
target: &1286 医务员，把她带走。

source: &636 Uh...hello?
&1772 We've got to get her out of this.
target: &1772 得把她救出来。

source: &1773 Get her out of that damned chair!
target: &1773 把她从那张该死的椅子上弄出来！

source: &1287 There's too much neural activity - the interrupt would leave her braindead.
target: &1287 神经活动太强，中断连接会让她脑死亡。

source: &1288 We'll have to find something we can do at this end...
target: &1288 得看看我们这边还能做些什么……

source: &1289 REGIS!! Hang on!
target: &1289 里吉斯！等等！

source: &1774 There are a few things I regret.
target: &1774 有些事，我一直后悔。

source: &1775 No matter what I do, there's nothing that can change most of them.
target: &1775 无论做什么，大部分都没法改变。

source: &1290 She's safe, Regis! You got her out!
target: &1290 她安全了，里吉斯！你救出她了！

source: &1776 That's good.
&1777 Maybe, with what I've done now, I can fix the most important ones.
target: &1777 也许，今天做的事，能让我弥补其中最重要的那些。

source: &1291 Hang on, Regis! We're almost in!
target: &1291 坚持住，里吉斯！我们快进来了！

source: &1778 I've wasted so many years...out of shame...out of fear...
target: &1778 因为羞愧，因为恐惧，我浪费了这么多年……

source: &1779 If I had...one more chance...one...more...
target: &1779 要是还能……有一次机会……再……一次……

source: &1292 Regis? Regis?!
target: &1292 里吉斯？里吉斯？！

source: &1293 I can't feel anything...get the medic!
target: &1293 感觉不到任何动静……叫医务员！

source: &1294 Don't do this...don't do this, Charlie...
target: &1294 别这样……别这样，查理……

source: &1780 It's the memory module we pulled from Van der Waal's refrigerator.
target: &1780 这是我们从范德瓦尔冰箱里拿到的记忆模块。

source: &1781 Now it's hooked into the system, and uploading God knows what into Latha...
target: &1781 现在它接进了系统，鬼知道正往拉塔脑子里上传什么……

source: &1295 The wetware inside is glowing. It must be active.
target: &1295 里面的湿件在发光，肯定正在运行。

source: &1782 Can we just pull the module?
target: &1782 不能直接拔掉模块吗？

source: &1296 I don't think so - the interrupt in the dataflow will probably leave her brain-damaged.
target: &1296 应该不行。数据流一中断，她很可能会受到脑损伤。

source: &1297 Maybe if we could get it to stop the transfer, though...
target: &1297 不过，要是能让它自己停止传输……

source: &1783 I can't risk just pulling it out.
target: &1783 不能冒险直接拔掉。

source: &1784 Interrupting the connection like that might harm Latha.
target: &1784 那样切断连接，可能伤到拉塔。

source: &1785 What's with all the water?
target: &1785 这么多水是怎么回事？

source: &1298 It's a coolant. The systems work at their peak around negative-forty celsius.
target: &1298 冷却剂。系统在零下四十摄氏度左右，运作效率最高。

source: &1786 She must have cut the power to the coolant systems to work in here.
target: &1786 她一定切断了冷却系统的电源，才好在这里工作。

source: &1299 I don't think the wetware in the module would like it either.
target: &1299 模块里的湿件，应该也受不了这种温度。

source: &1787 It's like a giant freezer for the electronic systems.
target: &1787 就像个巨大的电子系统冷冻库。

source: &1788 I guess Galatea had to raise the temperature for herself, and the organic wetware in the memory module.
target: &1788 伽拉忒亚肯定是为自己，还有记忆模块里的有机湿件，把温度调高了。

source: &1789 Can we do anything to the cortex servers themselves?
target: &1789 能对皮层服务器本身做点什么吗？

source: &1300 If we had more time, I could hook my own wetware up to it.
target: &1300 如果有更多时间，我可以把自己的湿件接进去。

source: &1301 It'd take hours to sort through the normal operational garbage, though.
target: &1301 可光是筛过日常运作的杂乱数据，就得好几个小时。

source: &1790 I wouldn't know where to begin - that's Lao's field...
target: &1790 根本不知道从哪里下手，这是劳的领域……

source: &1791 Lao, do you think we could...?
target: &1791 劳，你觉得我们能不能……？

source: &1302 I know what you're thinking, and the answer's 'no'.
target: &1302 我知道你在想什么，答案是“不行”。

source: &1303 The systems are well-shielded against charge surges.
target: &1303 系统对电荷浪涌有完善的防护。

source: &1304 Sorry...unlike at Van der Waal's, the 'shoot it' approach won't help.
target: &1304 抱歉……这里跟范德瓦尔家不一样，“朝它开枪”没用。

source: &678 A door at the end of the walkway, hiding another panel.
target: &678 走道尽头的一扇门，里面藏着另一块面板。

source: &1792 A power switch? It's been turned off.
target: &1792 电源开关？被关掉了。

source: &1793 Lao, why was the memory module in Van der Waal's refrigerator?
target: &1793 劳，范德瓦尔为什么把记忆模块放在冰箱里？

source: &1305 I don't know for sure, but I think because of its wetware.
target: &1305 不确定，不过我想，是因为里面的湿件。

source: &1306 Like any organic system, it has a peak temperature at which it operates, about fifteen celsius.
target: &1306 跟所有有机系统一样，它有一个最佳运作温度，大约十五摄氏度。

source: &1794 So, he might have been trying to get it to stop, by lowering its temperature?
target: &1794 所以，他可能是想降温，让它停下来？

source: &1307 Unsuccessfully, since it managed to overwrite his wetware.
target: &1307 没成功。它还是覆盖了他的湿件。

source: &1795 But the theory's sound, right?
target: &1795 可理论上，行得通，对吧？

source: &1308 Hey! Stop!
&1796 His kitchen refrigerator wasn't enough.
target: &1796 他厨房的冰箱，温度还不够低。

source: &1797 If we power up the freezer in here, we can bring it down to negative-forty.
target: &1797 启动这里的冷冻系统，就能降到零下四十。

source: &1309 If you power it up now, the door will lock as the system cycles.
target: &1309 你现在启动它，系统循环时，门就会锁上。

source: &1310 Yeah, but we'd be trapped in here for at least four hours, in lethal cold.
target: &1310 可我们会在致命的低温里，困上至少四个小时。

source: &1311 I want to save Latha, but I'm not gonna let you freeze us to death doing it.
target: &1311 我也想救拉塔，但不能让你把我们都冻死。

source: &1798 That's fine - get outside before I throw the switch!
target: &1798 那就没问题，我拉开关之前，你先出去！

source: &1312 I can't let you do this, Regis!
target: &1312 不能让你这么做，里吉斯！

source: &1799 What are you going to do, stun me?
target: &1799 你打算怎么办？电晕我？

source: &1313 If I have to.
target: &1313 必要的话，会。

source: &1314 But I don't think you're going to risk killing me in here. If I stay, you live.
target: &1314 可我不认为，你会冒险把我害死在这里。我留下，你就能活。

source: &141 Warning - coolant systems active. Target value: NEGATIVE FORTY celsius.
target: &141 警告——冷却系统已启用。目标值：零下四十摄氏度。

source: &142 Beginning maintenance cycle. Estimated completion: SIX HOURS.
target: &142 开始维护周期。预计完成时间：六小时。

source: &37 Warning - cooling systems active. Target value: NEGATIVE FORTY celsius.
target: &37 警告——冷却系统已启用。目标值：零下四十摄氏度。

source: &38 Beginning maintenance cycle. Estimated completion: SIX HOURS.
target: &38 开始维护周期。预计完成时间：六小时。

source: &1800 Nothing else I can do, now.
target: &1800 现在，我再也做不了别的了。

source: &748 The power cut-off for the server's refrigeration. Apparently deactivated by Galatea to give her a chance to do her work.
target: &748 服务器冷却系统的断电开关。显然，是伽拉忒亚为了能在里面工作，把它关掉了。
